title: Contract Conditions on Meal Periods Credited for Each Claim Day (Workplace Cafe Management Program)
content:
Where the service model serves two or more meal periods each operating day and three or more net claim days stand, each net claim day is credited for every meal period the service model serves that day. Where the service model serves two or more meal periods each operating day and fewer than three net claim days stand, each net claim day is credited for every meal period the service model serves that day less one period in all, and never below nil. Where the service model serves one meal period each operating day, each net claim day is credited as one meal period.

The net claim days are the claim days counted less the claim days set aside, and never below nil. The meal periods the service model serves each operating day are those the service model in force on the workplace cafe management contract under the Workplace Cafe Management Program serves at the cafe counter.

Condition, judgement and result:

| Meal periods the service model serves each operating day | Net claim days standing | Credited meal periods |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 3 or more | every meal period the service model serves that day, for each net claim day |
| 2 or more | fewer than 3 | every meal period the service model serves that day, for each net claim day, less one period in all, and never below nil |
| 1 | any number | one meal period for each net claim day |

The deduction of one period in the second condition is taken once in all and not once for each net claim day, and where that deduction would carry the credited meal periods below nil the credited meal periods are nil.

Worked on hypothetical records. A service model hypothetically serving 3 meal periods each operating day, with 4 net claim days standing, is credited 12 meal periods. The same service model with 2 net claim days standing is credited 6 meal periods less one period in all, that is 5 meal periods. A service model hypothetically serving 2 meal periods each operating day with 3 net claim days standing is credited 6 meal periods, while the same service model with fewer than three net claim days, say 1 net claim day, is credited 2 meal periods less one period in all, that is 1 meal period. A service model hypothetically serving 1 meal period each operating day is credited one meal period for each net claim day, whether 1 net claim day stands or 8 stand.
